initial_scene: Middle third-person view only: an active white-and-blue arm with open two-finger gripper above the back of an orange-covered tabletop; a small round green plate is left of a red-purple grape bunch lying on the right. A second arm remains idle in the lower-left foreground; black backdrop and gray tabletop edges are visible.

observed_sequence.action: The active arm moves its open gripper forward and down toward the red-purple grape bunch on the right; the plate remains empty.
The gripper lowers around the bunch and closes, with contact partly obscured by the fingers.
The arm lifts the grape bunch clear of its original tabletop position, holding it below the closed fingers.
The held bunch is carried left over the green plate and lowered to it.
The fingers open, leaving the grape bunch resting on the green plate with part extending beyond its far rim; the empty gripper withdraws upward/back and the bunch remains still.

After the placement and withdrawal, the gripper closes while empty and moves down to contact the bunch again, apparently nudging it farther onto the plate. The clip ends with the gripper low over the bunch and no second lift or withdrawal shown.

selected_segment.terminal_state: The grape bunch has been transferred onto the green plate and nudged farther onto it; the closed gripper remains low over the bunch at the final frame.
